English: The apartment comes with all the furnishings you need.
We spent a fortune on new furnishings for the living room.
The hotel's furnishings looked old and worn.
Portuguese: O apartamento vem com toda a mobília de que você precisa.
Gastamos uma fortuna com móveis novos para a sala.
A mobília do hotel parecia velha e gasta.

cards.meaning: The furniture, carpets, curtains, and other items in a room or house.

English: The skylight fills the kitchen with natural light.
We could see the stars through the skylight at night.
Rain was leaking through the old skylight.
Portuguese: A claraboia enche a cozinha de luz natural.
Dava para ver as estrelas pela claraboia à noite.
A chuva estava entrando pela claraboia velha.

cards.meaning: A window built into a roof or ceiling to let in light.

English: The house has a beautiful wooden staircase.
She walked slowly down the staircase.
The spiral staircase leads up to the attic.
Portuguese: A casa tem uma linda escadaria de madeira.
Ela desceu a escada devagar.
A escada em caracol leva até o sótão.

cards.meaning: A set of stairs inside a building, including its rails and structure.

English: It's a small but cosy flat.
We spent the evening in a cosy little café.
The fireplace makes the living room feel really cosy.
Portuguese: É um apartamento pequeno, mas aconchegante.
Passamos a noite em um cafezinho aconchegante.
A lareira deixa a sala bem aconchegante.

cards.meaning: Warm, comfortable, and pleasant, especially in a small space (British spelling of cozy).

English: The closet was crammed with old clothes.
Six of us were crammed into a tiny apartment.
Every shelf was crammed with books.
Portuguese: O armário estava abarrotado de roupas velhas.
Nós seis estávamos espremidos em um apartamento minúsculo.
Todas as prateleiras estavam abarrotadas de livros.

cards.meaning: Completely full of things or people, with no free space.

English: She decorated the shelves with handmade pottery.
We bought some local pottery on our trip.
The pottery on the dining table was a wedding gift.
Portuguese: Ela decorou as prateleiras com cerâmica feita à mão.
Compramos algumas peças de cerâmica local na viagem.
A cerâmica na mesa de jantar foi um presente de casamento.

cards.meaning: Pots, dishes, and other objects made from baked clay.

English: The new apartment is much roomier than the old one.
It's a roomy house with four bedrooms.
The kitchen is roomy enough for a big table.
Portuguese: O apartamento novo é muito mais espaçoso que o antigo.
É uma casa espaçosa com quatro quartos.
A cozinha é espaçosa o bastante para uma mesa grande.

cards.meaning: Having plenty of space inside.

English: The house has a plain interior with white walls.
I prefer a plain interior to a lot of decoration.
Behind the colorful front door was a surprisingly plain interior.
Portuguese: A casa tem um interior simples com paredes brancas.
Prefiro um interior simples a muita decoração.
Atrás da porta colorida havia um interior surpreendentemente simples.

cards.meaning: The inside of a building or room decorated simply, without much ornament.

terms.Portuguese: esvaziar por completo (para reformar); demolir o interior

English: We're going to gut the bathroom and put in new tiles.
The new owners gutted the house before moving in.
It's cheaper to repair the walls than to gut the whole place.
Portuguese: Vamos demolir o banheiro por dentro e colocar azulejos novos.
Os novos donos esvaziaram a casa toda por dentro antes de se mudar.
É mais barato consertar as paredes do que demolir o interior do lugar inteiro.

cards.meaning: To remove all the inside parts of a building or room, usually in order to rebuild them.

English: We keep the Christmas decorations in the attic.
They turned the attic into an extra bedroom.
I found some old photos in a box in the attic.
Portuguese: Guardamos os enfeites de Natal no sótão.
Eles transformaram o sótão em um quarto extra.
Encontrei umas fotos antigas numa caixa no sótão.

cards.meaning: The space or room just below the roof of a house.

English: The washing machine is down in the basement.
Our basement flooded after the storm.
He built a home gym in the basement.
Portuguese: A máquina de lavar fica lá embaixo no porão.
Nosso porão inundou depois da tempestade.
Ele montou uma academia em casa no porão.

cards.meaning: A floor of a building that is partly or completely below ground level.

English: We like to sit on the porch in the evening.
Leave the package on the front porch.
The porch light was still on when I got home.
Portuguese: Gostamos de sentar na varanda à noite.
Deixe o pacote na varanda da frente.
A luz da varanda ainda estava acesa quando cheguei em casa.

cards.meaning: A covered area at the entrance of a house.

English: There's a car parked in our driveway.
He spent the morning shoveling snow off the driveway.
The kids were drawing with chalk on the driveway.
Portuguese: Tem um carro estacionado na nossa entrada.
Ele passou a manhã tirando neve da entrada da garagem.
As crianças estavam desenhando com giz na entrada da casa.

cards.meaning: A short private road leading from the street to a house or garage.

English: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.
We hung family photos along the hallway.
Please don't leave your shoes in the hallway.
Portuguese: O banheiro fica no fim do corredor.
Penduramos fotos da família ao longo do corredor.
Por favor, não deixe seus sapatos no corredor.

cards.meaning: A passage inside a building that connects rooms.

English: Hold on to the banister when you go down.
The kids loved sliding down the banister.
We painted the banister white.
Portuguese: Segure no corrimão quando descer.
As crianças adoravam escorregar pelo corrimão.
Pintamos o corrimão de branco.

cards.meaning: The rail along the side of a staircase that you hold onto.

English: She grows herbs on the kitchen windowsill.
The cat likes to sleep on the windowsill.
There was dust all over the windowsill.
Portuguese: Ela cultiva ervas no parapeito da janela da cozinha.
O gato gosta de dormir no parapeito da janela.
Havia poeira por todo o parapeito da janela.

cards.meaning: The flat shelf at the bottom of a window.

English: Please wipe your feet on the doormat.
I left the spare key under the doormat.
The doormat says 'Welcome Home'.
Portuguese: Por favor, limpe os pés no capacho.
Deixei a chave reserva embaixo do capacho.
O capacho diz 'Bem-vindo ao lar'.

cards.meaning: A mat placed at a door for people to wipe their shoes on.

English: Can you close the blinds? The sun is in my eyes.
We installed new blinds in the bedroom.
Light came through the gaps in the blinds.
Portuguese: Você pode fechar as persianas? O sol está no meu rosto.
Instalamos persianas novas no quarto.
A luz entrava pelas frestas das persianas.

cards.meaning: Window coverings made of strips or a sheet that can be raised, lowered, or angled.

English: We put a big rug in the living room.
The dog fell asleep on the rug.
I spilled coffee on the new rug.
Portuguese: Colocamos um tapete grande na sala.
O cachorro dormiu no tapete.
Derramei café no tapete novo.

cards.meaning: A piece of thick material that covers part of a floor.

English: It's cold tonight, so I'll use the thick duvet.
She pulled the duvet over her head.
I need a new cover for my duvet.
Portuguese: Está frio hoje, então vou usar o edredom grosso.
Ela puxou o edredom por cima da cabeça.
Preciso de uma capa nova para o meu edredom.

cards.meaning: A thick, soft cover filled with feathers or other material, used on a bed.

English: Hang your jacket in the wardrobe.
The bedroom has a built-in wardrobe.
My wardrobe is too small for all my clothes.
Portuguese: Pendure sua jaqueta no guarda-roupa.
O quarto tem um guarda-roupa embutido.
Meu guarda-roupa é pequeno demais para todas as minhas roupas.

cards.meaning: A tall piece of furniture where you hang clothes.

English: I keep a glass of water on my nightstand.
My phone is charging on the nightstand.
There's a lamp and a book on the nightstand.
Portuguese: Deixo um copo de água no meu criado-mudo.
Meu celular está carregando na mesa de cabeceira.
Tem um abajur e um livro no criado-mudo.

cards.meaning: A small table beside a bed.

English: The kitchen faucet is dripping again.
Turn off the faucet while you brush your teeth.
We replaced the old faucet with a new one.
Portuguese: A torneira da cozinha está pingando de novo.
Feche a torneira enquanto escova os dentes.
Trocamos a torneira velha por uma nova.

cards.meaning: A device that controls the flow of water from a pipe (American English; British: tap).

English: The kitchen has granite countertops.
Don't leave dirty dishes on the countertop.
She rolled out the dough on the countertop.
Portuguese: A cozinha tem bancadas de granito.
Não deixe louça suja na bancada.
Ela abriu a massa na bancada.

cards.meaning: The flat work surface in a kitchen.

English: The glasses are in the cupboard above the sink.
We need more cupboard space in the kitchen.
There's nothing to eat in the cupboards.
Portuguese: Os copos estão no armário em cima da pia.
Precisamos de mais espaço de armário na cozinha.
Não tem nada para comer nos armários.

cards.meaning: A piece of furniture or a built-in space with doors and shelves, used for storing dishes or food.

English: There's rice and pasta in the pantry.
We keep the pantry well stocked.
She organized the pantry with labeled jars.
Portuguese: Tem arroz e macarrão na despensa.
Mantemos a despensa bem abastecida.
Ela organizou a despensa com potes etiquetados.

cards.meaning: A small room or cupboard where food is stored.

English: Is there an outlet near the bed?
Don't plug too many things into one outlet.
The outlet in the kitchen stopped working.
Portuguese: Tem alguma tomada perto da cama?
Não ligue coisas demais em uma tomada só.
A tomada da cozinha parou de funcionar.

cards.meaning: A place in a wall where you plug in electrical equipment (American English; British: socket).

English: I couldn't find the light switch in the dark.
The light switch is next to the door.
Someone left fingerprints all over the light switch.
Portuguese: Não consegui achar o interruptor no escuro.
O interruptor fica ao lado da porta.
Alguém deixou marcas de dedo por todo o interruptor.

cards.meaning: A small device on a wall used to turn lights on and off.

English: Smoke was rising from the chimney.
We had the chimney cleaned before winter.
Birds built a nest in our chimney.
Portuguese: A fumaça subia da chaminé.
Mandamos limpar a chaminé antes do inverno.
Uns pássaros fizeram um ninho na nossa chaminé.

cards.meaning: A structure that carries smoke from a fire up and out through the roof.

English: We sat by the fireplace and drank hot chocolate.
The living room has a stone fireplace.
They hung stockings above the fireplace.
Portuguese: Sentamos perto da lareira e tomamos chocolate quente.
A sala tem uma lareira de pedra.
Eles penduraram meias em cima da lareira.

cards.meaning: An open place in a wall of a room where a fire is lit.

English: The gutters are full of leaves.
Water is overflowing from the gutter.
He climbed a ladder to clean the gutters.
Portuguese: As calhas estão cheias de folhas.
A água está transbordando da calha.
Ele subiu numa escada para limpar as calhas.

cards.meaning: A channel along the edge of a roof that carries rainwater away.

English: The lawn mower is in the shed.
He spends hours in his garden shed.
We built a small shed in the backyard.
Portuguese: O cortador de grama está no galpão.
Ele passa horas no depósito do jardim.
Construímos um pequeno galpão no quintal.

cards.meaning: A small simple building, usually in a garden, used for storing tools.

English: The floorboards creak when you walk on them.
We sanded and varnished the old floorboards.
One of the floorboards in the hall is loose.
Portuguese: As tábuas do assoalho rangem quando você pisa nelas.
Lixamos e envernizamos as tábuas antigas do assoalho.
Uma das tábuas do assoalho do corredor está solta.

cards.meaning: One of the long wooden boards that make up a floor.

English: We're going to take down the old wallpaper.
The bedroom has flowery wallpaper.
The wallpaper is peeling off in the corner.
Portuguese: Vamos tirar o papel de parede velho.
O quarto tem papel de parede florido.
O papel de parede está descolando no canto.

cards.meaning: Decorative paper used to cover the walls of a room.

English: We took out a mortgage to buy our first home.
Most of my salary goes to the mortgage.
They finally paid off their mortgage last year.
Portuguese: Fizemos um financiamento para comprar nossa primeira casa.
A maior parte do meu salário vai para o financiamento.
Eles finalmente quitaram o financiamento no ano passado.

cards.meaning: A loan used to buy a house, paid back over many years.

English: Our landlord raised the rent again.
I called the landlord about the broken heater.
The landlord doesn't allow pets.
Portuguese: Nosso senhorio aumentou o aluguel de novo.
Liguei para o proprietário por causa do aquecedor quebrado.
O proprietário não permite animais de estimação.

cards.meaning: A person who owns a house or apartment and rents it to others.

English: The previous tenants left the place very clean.
Tenants must give one month's notice before leaving.
The landlord is looking for a new tenant.
Portuguese: Os inquilinos anteriores deixaram o lugar bem limpo.
Os inquilinos precisam avisar com um mês de antecedência antes de sair.
O proprietário está procurando um novo inquilino.

cards.meaning: A person who pays rent to live in a house or apartment.

English: We signed a one-year lease.
Our lease ends in December.
Read the lease carefully before you sign it.
Portuguese: Assinamos um contrato de aluguel de um ano.
Nosso contrato de aluguel termina em dezembro.
Leia o contrato de aluguel com atenção antes de assinar.

cards.meaning: A legal agreement to rent a property for a period of time.

English: Does the rent include utility bills?
Our utility bills are higher in the winter.
We split the utility bills between the three of us.
Portuguese: O aluguel inclui as contas de luz, água e gás?
Nossas contas de consumo são mais altas no inverno.
Dividimos as contas de consumo entre nós três.

cards.meaning: Regular bills for services such as electricity, water, and gas.

English: My desk is so cluttered that I can't find anything.
The garage is cluttered with old boxes.
A cluttered room can make you feel stressed.
Portuguese: Minha mesa está tão bagunçada que não consigo achar nada.
A garagem está entulhada de caixas velhas.
Um cômodo bagunçado pode deixar você estressado.

cards.meaning: Filled with too many things in an untidy way.

English: The apartment was cramped and dark.
Four of us shared a cramped bedroom.
The kitchen feels cramped with the new fridge.
Portuguese: O apartamento era apertado e escuro.
Nós quatro dividíamos um quarto apertado.
A cozinha fica apertada com a geladeira nova.

cards.meaning: Too small for the people or things in it; uncomfortable because of lack of space.

terms.Portuguese: com corrente de ar; cheio de frestas

English: The old house is drafty in winter.
We need to fix those drafty windows.
It's a lovely room, but a bit drafty.
Portuguese: A casa velha tem muita corrente de ar no inverno.
Precisamos consertar aquelas janelas cheias de frestas.
É um quarto lindo, mas entra um pouco de vento frio.

cards.meaning: Letting cold air come in, usually through gaps in windows or doors.

English: We called a plumber to fix the leaky pipe.
The leaky roof let rain into the attic.
That leaky faucet kept me awake all night.
Portuguese: Chamamos um encanador para consertar o cano com vazamento.
O telhado com goteira deixou a chuva entrar no sótão.
Aquela torneira pingando me deixou acordado a noite toda.

cards.meaning: Having a hole or crack that lets water or air escape or come in.

English: We're renovating the kitchen this summer.
They bought an old farmhouse and renovated it.
It took two years to renovate the whole apartment.
Portuguese: Vamos reformar a cozinha neste verão.
Eles compraram uma casa de fazenda antiga e a reformaram.
Levou dois anos para reformar o apartamento inteiro.

cards.meaning: To repair and improve a building or room so that it is in good condition again.

English: I spent the weekend decluttering my closet.
Decluttering the house made it feel so much bigger.
We need to declutter before we move.
Portuguese: Passei o fim de semana destralhando meu armário.
Tirar o excesso de coisas da casa fez ela parecer muito maior.
Precisamos desentulhar antes de nos mudarmos.

cards.meaning: To remove things you do not need from a place to make it tidier.

English: The plumbing in this old house needs to be replaced.
There's something wrong with the plumbing upstairs.
Fixing the plumbing cost more than we expected.
Portuguese: O encanamento desta casa velha precisa ser trocado.
Tem algo errado com o encanamento lá em cima.
Consertar a parte hidráulica custou mais do que esperávamos.

cards.meaning: The system of pipes and fixtures that carries water through a building.

English: The electrician said the wiring is unsafe.
We had to replace all the wiring in the house.
Faulty wiring can cause a fire.
Portuguese: O eletricista disse que a fiação não é segura.
Tivemos que trocar toda a fiação da casa.
Fiação com defeito pode causar um incêndio.

cards.meaning: The system of electrical wires in a building.

English: Good insulation keeps the house warm in winter.
We added insulation to the attic.
Poor insulation means higher heating bills.
Portuguese: Um bom isolamento mantém a casa quente no inverno.
Colocamos isolamento térmico no sótão.
Isolamento ruim significa contas de aquecimento mais altas.

cards.meaning: Material used to stop heat or sound from passing through walls, roofs, or floors.

English: Can you turn the thermostat down a little?
We set the thermostat to 20 degrees.
The new thermostat can be controlled from your phone.
Portuguese: Você pode baixar um pouco o termostato?
Ajustamos o termostato para 20 graus.
O termostato novo pode ser controlado pelo celular.

cards.meaning: A device that controls the temperature of a heating or cooling system.

English: I love the layout of this apartment.
The kitchen has an awkward layout.
We changed the layout to make the living room bigger.
Portuguese: Adoro a planta deste apartamento.
A cozinha tem uma disposição estranha.
Mudamos a planta para deixar a sala maior.

cards.meaning: The way the rooms and spaces of a house or apartment are arranged.

English: The apartment has an open-plan kitchen and living room.
Open-plan homes feel bigger and brighter.
I'm not sure I'd like an open-plan layout with small kids.
Portuguese: O apartamento tem cozinha e sala integradas.
Casas de conceito aberto parecem maiores e mais claras.
Não sei se eu gostaria de uma planta aberta com crianças pequenas.

cards.meaning: Having few or no walls between areas such as the kitchen, dining, and living room.

English: The master bedroom has an en suite.
Each room in the hotel has an en suite bathroom.
We're adding an en suite to the guest room.
Portuguese: O quarto principal tem banheiro privativo.
Cada quarto do hotel tem um banheiro privativo.
Vamos fazer uma suíte no quarto de hóspedes.

cards.meaning: A bathroom connected directly to a bedroom.

English: We bought a fixer-upper and renovated it ourselves.
That house is a real fixer-upper.
Fixer-uppers are cheaper, but the repairs add up.
Portuguese: Compramos um imóvel para reformar e fizemos a reforma nós mesmos.
Aquela casa precisa de uma reforma completa.
Imóveis para reformar são mais baratos, mas os consertos vão somando.

cards.meaning: A house in poor condition that needs repairs, often sold at a low price.

terms.Portuguese: festa de casa nova; chá de casa nova

English: We're having a housewarming on Saturday.
She brought a plant as a housewarming gift.
Everyone from work came to our housewarming party.
Portuguese: Vamos dar uma festa de casa nova no sábado.
Ela trouxe uma planta de presente de casa nova.
Todo mundo do trabalho veio à nossa festa de casa nova.

cards.meaning: A party held to celebrate moving into a new home.

English: We share the household chores equally.
I usually do the household chores on Sunday.
The kids help with some household chores.
Portuguese: Dividimos as tarefas domésticas igualmente.
Costumo fazer as tarefas domésticas no domingo.
As crianças ajudam com algumas tarefas domésticas.

cards.meaning: Regular jobs done at home, such as cleaning, cooking, and washing.

English: The apartment comes with all the kitchen appliances.
We bought new appliances when we moved in.
Unplug small appliances when you're not using them.
Portuguese: O apartamento vem com todos os eletrodomésticos da cozinha.
Compramos eletrodomésticos novos quando nos mudamos.
Tire da tomada os aparelhos pequenos quando não estiver usando.

cards.meaning: A machine used in the home, such as a fridge, washing machine, or microwave.

English: The package was left on the doorstep.
She was waiting for me on the doorstep.
There's a great bakery right on our doorstep.
Portuguese: O pacote foi deixado na porta de casa.
Ela estava me esperando na soleira da porta.
Tem uma ótima padaria bem na porta da nossa casa.

cards.meaning: The step or area right outside the front door of a house.

English: The doorbell rang while I was in the shower.
Please ring the doorbell when you arrive.
We installed a video doorbell last month.
Portuguese: A campainha tocou enquanto eu estava no banho.
Por favor, toque a campainha quando chegar.
Instalamos uma campainha com câmera no mês passado.

cards.meaning: A bell or buzzer outside a front door that visitors press.

English: The kids are playing in the backyard.
We had a barbecue in the backyard.
Their backyard has a small vegetable garden.
Portuguese: As crianças estão brincando no quintal.
Fizemos um churrasco no quintal.
O quintal deles tem uma pequena horta.

cards.meaning: The area of land behind a house, often with grass or a garden.

English: She placed a cushion on the wooden chair.
The cushion softened the seat.
He used a cushion to support his back.
Portuguese: Ela colocou uma almofada na cadeira de madeira.
A almofada deixou o assento mais macio.
Ele usou uma almofada para apoiar as costas.

cards.meaning: A soft pillow used to make a seat more comfortable.

English: They moved into a spacious apartment with large windows.
The kitchen feels spacious after we removed the old table.
We need a spacious room for the whole team.
Portuguese: Eles se mudaram para um apartamento espaçoso com janelas grandes.
A cozinha parece ampla depois que tiramos a mesa velha.
Precisamos de uma sala espaçosa para a equipe inteira.

cards.meaning: Having a lot of space.
